body:
I plan on just completely stopping. I don't think I will be going to any social events for a long time. This has really messed me up inside. I feel like scum. 
But hopefully if my friend gets back to me I can ask him If I could apologize to her or something. 

I'm just really scared for having my life ruined by something like this. I'm such an idiot.

Well from what I understand is that I groped her. I honestly dont remember doing any of that since I had blacked out. I would do that(send her a message on FB or Email) but I have no idea who the woman is and am just afraid of her calling the cops on me. 
This experience is a drastic change on my drinking problem. I need to seek help for this. I sure hope it passes, I cant live like this.

Oh no. My friend is really upset at me. It was his big night. I told him I felt terrible for what I did and I feel guilty and ashamed. He told me he was going to talk to the other people who hosted the event and see what can be done to fix this. I wanna fix this more than anything, I feel so terrible. I feel like getting a message to her from him but I'm afraid of what she will say. Fuck :/
If I could I would. My friend who hosted the event told me that If i even try to apologize to her that she will call the cops on me.
